name: Set Up Full Floor Protection (Spray)
intent: Roll out plastic sheeting across the entire floor and tape seams. Required for any spray application to prevent overspray contact with floor finish. Stays in place through prime and finish; the finish scenario inspects it rather than re-installing it.
doctrine: Setup rate (400 SF/hr) is slower than teardown rate (600 SF/hr) because installation requires careful seam taping and corner fitting. Tearing down is faster — bunched plastic, tape rips. Modifiers don't apply: setup is mechanical work and room shape doesn't materially affect plastic-roll-out time. Only fires when application_method is spray-based AND the room has finished or partial flooring to protect.
